name: walkers_cast_b
prompt:
Two earlier attempts went wrong in opposite ways: one drew everyone broad and stocky, the next too thin and seen too much from the front. This time: ordinary average builds, and the camera clearly high.

One image is attached: finished art from the same 2D city game, cars seen from above. Match its finish and light only — not its contents, colours or scale.

Make one image: 9 different people for the game, in a grid of 3 columns by 3 rows, read left to right, top to bottom. Each stands still, the whole body facing south — straight down the picture, towards its bottom edge — arms relaxed at the sides, feet side by side, a relaxed neutral expression, head level. The camera is in front and high above, looking down at about 55 degrees: the top of the head and the tops of the shoulders show plainly, the face is seen from above and a little shortened, the legs shorter on the picture than the body above them, the feet tucked just under the hem. Looking down shortens a body top to bottom only; it never makes it wider. Every figure has an ordinary average build — neither thin nor stocky, shoulders their natural width. The whole body is visible. Each is centred in its cell, well apart from its neighbours, never touching. All at one scale: a person 1.8 m tall fills about 70 % of the cell's height, shorter people smaller in proportion.

Style: game sprite art with a light pixel-art feel — clean simplified shapes, bold readable silhouettes, a limited palette with flat shading in two or three tones per colour, crisp hard edges. Leave small details out: no fabric texture, no stitching, no tiny patterns; faces simple, eyes, brows and mouth a few marks. Each must read clearly when shown only 60 pixels tall. Not photographic, not soft painting, not chibi: natural adult proportions. Summer in a Black Sea port city.

The people, in order:
1. A woman of about 30, 1.68 m: long dark-brown hair in a ponytail, plain red T-shirt, light-blue denim shorts, white trainers.
2. A man of about 35, 1.82 m: short curly dark hair, short beard, plain navy T-shirt, mid-blue jeans, white trainers.
3. A grey-haired man of about 65, 1.76 m: light-brown linen jacket open over a cream shirt, dark-grey trousers, brown shoes.
4. A young woman of about 20, 1.65 m: short blond bob, plain yellow sundress, tan sandals.
5. A boy of about 15, 1.70 m: black hoodie, grey joggers, black trainers.
6. A woman of about 45, 1.66 m: dark hair in a bun, white blouse, dark-blue knee-length skirt, flat black shoes.
7. A man of about 25, 1.80 m: shaved head, green polo shirt, beige chino shorts, white trainers.
8. A woman of about 70, 1.60 m: short grey hair, lilac cardigan over a plain light-blue dress, beige shoes.
9. A man of about 40, 1.88 m: dark skin, short black hair, plain white short-sleeved shirt, black trousers, black shoes.

Everything outside the figures is fully transparent: no background, no ground, no shadow, nothing half-transparent. No text, letters, numbers, labels, grid lines or frames anywhere.
